# nest

concise context for llm coding agents working in this repository.

## what this is

single-file sovereign vector database. the .nest file IS the database: chunks, embeddings, source spans, optional hnsw/bm25/graph indices, and a search contract in one mmap-friendly container. agents get cited, hash-verified answers fully offline: no server, no api call, no socket at query time.

## project snapshot

- language stack: rust workspace (format, runtime, cli, pyo3 bindings) + python tooling (builder, embedders, measurement).
- architecture docs: doc/arc/arc.yaml (human and machine reference), doc/arc/arc.mmd (visual mermaid). the pair is the source of truth.
- .contracts/.agents/AGENTS.md is the agent and contributor operating contract and the single agent instruction source; use/update/init only .contracts/.agents/AGENTS.md, no per-tool instruction files.
- forge-core/ is a SEPARATE cargo workspace (ingestion layer, frozen .fci schema); not in the sovereign --workspace set, build it via --manifest-path forge-core/Cargo.toml.

## flagship verbs (agent-native)

text query in, cited answer out. offline by construction: the verbs embed with the vendored potion static table (numpy + tokenizers, no torch, no network) and validate the embedder's model_hash against the manifest.

- nest ask <file> "query" -k 3: prints the cited canonical text + a nest://content_hash/chunk_id citation. --disclose explain adds the rerank-source honesty line ("real cosine" vs "real cosine at stored precision").
- nest retrieve <file> "query" -k 3 --format jsonl: json/jsonl answer-pack; every hit's score IS the exact-cosine rerank value, with the tier-1 stored canonical text + verifying hashes + the citation.

engine subcommands (file + vector in, never run python): inspect, validate, stats, media, search, search-ann, search-graph, search-space, search-text, benchmark, cite, doctor. agent verbs (text or spec in, shell out to the offline python embedder / forge): ask, retrieve, build. `nest --help` groups them the same way; implementations live in crates/nest-cli/src/cmd/ (engine) and cmd/agent/ (agent).

## python entry

- sys.path.insert(0, "python"); import nest; db = nest.open(path)
- db.retrieve(qvec, k=5) is the agent-native path: routes by manifest capability, score IS the exact rerank value, each hit carries the tier-1 text + the nest:// citation.

## build and verification

- cargo build --workspace
- cargo build --release --workspace
- cargo test --workspace
- cargo fmt --all --check
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
- ./scripts/release_check.sh

prefer release_check.sh before merge, it is the project gate; .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the same gate (minus the lfs corpus measurement) on every push and pull request, plus the mutation-fuzz harnesses and a cargo-fuzz smoke. forge-core carries its own gate: cargo test --manifest-path forge-core/Cargo.toml.
- mutation fuzz: cargo test -p nest-format --test mutation_fuzz -p nest-runtime --test mutation_fuzz (NEST_MUTATION_ITERS scales it); coverage-guided targets in fuzz/ (cargo +nightly fuzz run <target>).

## coding practices

- rust edition 2024, resolver 3.
- no panic in library code, use typed errors.
- keep files small and single-responsibility.
- preserve deterministic behavior for hashing and index builds.
- unsafe: clippy denies undocumented unsafe blocks and unwrap() outside tests (workspace lints). nest-format has zero unsafe; the runtime's unsafe is the simd kernels and two mmap calls, each with a // SAFETY: comment. read fixed-width fields through nest_format::bytes, check header-derived sizes with checked arithmetic, write cursor bounds checks as need > remaining, sort f32 scores through nest_runtime::order.
- keep markdown lowercase, no emoji, no em dash.
- every change ships with real tests, no mocks, against real artifacts.

## format and runtime invariants

- format v1 is frozen; new sections and encodings are additive within v1.
- hash format: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
- content_hash must stay stable across non-semantic encodings.
- search score contract is cosine with exact rerank for ann/graph/hybrid paths.

## dataset policy

- dat/corpus_next.v1.nest is tracked with git lfs.
- dat/demo datasets are local-only and gitignored.
- dataset fetch commands and provenance are documented in dat/demo/README.md.
- the offline one-gif demo needs no datasets: python python/forge/retrieve.py.

## branch and release flow

- feature work targets dev (or feature branches based on dev).
- release flow is dev to main.
- main may enforce pr-only updates and required checks.

## do not

- do not force-push main.
- do not bypass release_check.sh.
- do not bump NEST_FORMAT_VERSION for additive changes.
- do not commit local demo datasets under dat/demo.
